title: Metadata and social preview basics
learningObjectives: Apply metadata and social preview basics accurately and accessibly.

understand.concept: title and description metadata describe a page; Open Graph metadata can influence link previews on supported platforms. Metadata does not guarantee search ranking or indexing.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct HTML semantics improve accessibility, maintainability and browser interoperability.
understand.analogy: Think of a document where every section has a clear role.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is limited; exact behaviour follows HTML semantics and browser rules.

explain.narrative: title and description metadata describe a page; Open Graph metadata can influence link previews on supported platforms. Metadata does not guarantee search ranking or indexing.

examples.code: <meta name="description" content="A beginner guide to HTML"><meta property="og:title" content="Learn HTML">
examples.explanation: Inspect the code, semantic roles, attributes and browser behaviour.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the HTML structure.

practise.guidedTask: Modify the example and test with keyboard and browser inspection.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible semantic page section and explain your element choices.
hints: Use CSS for appearance without changing semantics.
Do not rely only on browser defaults for security or accessibility.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Metadata and social preview basics</title></head><body>
<meta name="description" content="A beginner guide to HTML"><meta property="og:title" content="Learn HTML">
</body></html>
practice.resetCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Metadata and social preview basics</title></head><body>

</body></html>

questions.prompt: Does metadata guarantee a higher search ranking?
questions.explanation: Base decisions on semantic purpose, accessibility and browser behaviour.

questions.prompt: Does semantic HTML alone guarantee complete accessibility?
questions.explanation: Test keyboard access, labels, contrast and media alternatives.
